name: akoya_request-review-synthesis
_comment: Workbench Reviews tab Phase 4 (docs/WORKBENCH_REVIEWS_TAB_BUILDOUT_PLAN.md): AI synthesis of a proposal's submitted peer reviews, written by the Executor (lib/services/execute-prompt.js) via pages/api/review-manager/synthesize-reviews.js. ONE JSON Memo column holding the whole synthesis object ({consensus, disagreements, keyConcerns, ratingSummaries, overall}) rather than discrete fields — the shape is LLM-authored prose/lists, not server-filterable structured config (contrast wave7-reviewer-engagement, which is discrete BECAUSE the reminder cron $filters on it). PROVISIONED IN PRODUCTION by 2026-07-26; the current red gate is synthesis-output reliability, not schema availability. Regeneration deliberately overwrites the request memo.

attributes.description: AI-generated synthesis of this proposal's submitted peer reviews: {consensus: string[], disagreements: string[], keyConcerns: string[], ratingSummaries: [{questionKey, questionText, summary}], overall: string}. Regenerated on demand by staff (workbench Reviews tab 'Generate synthesis' / 'Regenerate' action) — always-overwrite target; the calling route, not a Dataverse guard, decides whether an existing value may be replaced.
